ingress.title: Sign in through Home Assistant
ingress.body: This page is served by Home Assistant, which signs you in to Meshloom: there is no Meshloom password to type here. Sign in to Home Assistant, then open Meshloom from its sidebar.
ingress.disabled: If you are already signed in to Home Assistant, a Meshloom administrator may have disabled your account.
